reviews.name: func_800642A0
reviews.evidence: The game-side SPU reset/init driver (_spu_init family, 0x548): the algorithm is real decompiled C (nine x3 software-timeout spins, SPUSTAT wait with retry, 24-voice table sweep, register sweep, convergent finish) with exactly ONE zero-byte memory-clobber barrier asm pinning the li-in-place shape law; registered as hybrid because semantic_c forbids inline asm while the substance is C. psyq 3.3 LIBSPU carries the same idiom but is not byte-identical (game copy compiled by the game's own cc1).
